headers.name: x-nf-request-id
headers.source: https://answers.netlify.com/t/support-guide-netlify-support-asked-for-the-x-nf-request-id-header-what-is-it-and-how-do-i-find-it/4385 (Netlify support guide, last reviewed in July 2025: Netlify adds x-nf-request-id to every response it sends, 404 and redirects included), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.netlify.com, www.gatsbyjs.com, kubernetes.io, www.vuejs.org, www.babeljs.io, www.reactnative.dev and www.prettier.io

headers.name: cache-status
headers.source: https://docs.netlify.com/build/caching/caching-overview/ (example Cache-Status values of the Netlify CDN, such as "Netlify Edge"; hit and "Netlify Edge"; fwd=miss), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.netlify.com, www.gatsbyjs.com and kubernetes.io. The pattern lets another cache list its own entry before or after Netlify's

cookies.name: nf_ab
cookies.source: https://docs.netlify.com/manage/monitoring/split-testing/ (Netlify sets the nf_ab cookie so that a visitor of a split test always gets the same branch, and its CDN reads it)
